question: Within a radius of 50 kilometers, where can I locate café on the journey from IIT Stuart School of Business, Chicago, IL to the Guesthouse Hotel, Chicago, IL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.642109 41.879101)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.667958 41.97094)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.642109 41.879101)',4326)::geography, 50000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.642109 41.879101)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
